HOME SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Decomposers only

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family.

7. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.

9. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Overview of Home Science? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Overview of Home Science.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Overview of Home Science.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Overview of Home Science.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Overview of Home Science.

16. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
